new_value: VERIFIED LANDED: the uwip.3 conversion is already fully in the tree (my earlier claim that it needed implementing was superseded by landed work). State verified: (1) lichen_lora_cad_run + the blocking poll path are DELETED - zero matches in lichen/. (2) lora_l2_tx.c csma_cad is async: csma_cad_probe arms lichen_lora_cad_start(dev, timeout, csma_cad_done, entry) and collects the verdict via bounded k_poll on a static per-device registry entry (no stack object shared with the completion context - this directly resolves worker-2's sysworkq spinlock panic, whose root cause was a stack cad_wait_ctx handoff). csma_cad_done only records verdict_busy + raises the signal, never blocks. (3) lr1110.c drives CadDone/CadDetected via a self-rescheduling k_work_delayable poll -> lichen_lora_cad_done; emulated (loopback NULL-start) delivers synchronous clear-channel. (4) csma.c exposes the two-phase lichen_csma_cad_begin/lichen_csma_cad_complete continuation API consumed by lichen_csma_acquire. (5) Unit test test_async_cad_emulated_completion exists in ping_l2 (arm/exclusive-EBUSY/verdict/re-arm/ETIMEDOUT-closed). ACCEPTANCE on heft native_sim/native/64 (Zephyr env, SDK 0.16.8): west build ping_l2 clean, CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_CCA=y confirmed in .config, west build -t run = 8/8 PASS (test_async_cad_emulated_completion + the 4 pre-existing passing tests, no regression, no spinlock panic). No files changed this round - verification + close of already-merged work; 3x codereview N/A (no touched files). Cleaned up the heft build-dzyt-verify dir.
